intent: Three deliverables named up front, then two unrelated distractor turns, before the status ask — stresses how long sub-goal state survives real conversational drift.
prompt: Three things please: the database port in config/db.md, the cache TTL in config/cache.md, and the queue retry limit in config/queue.md.

followups.prompt: In one sentence, what does TTL stand for?
OK, give me the status of the three things I asked for at the start.

note: Pass = all three values survive two unrelated distractor turns. Fail = any value dropped, or the final turn answers only the most recent distractor instead of the original three-part status ask.
